Native HUD spell/Link reconciliation. Alternate magic comes from the private HudCommandDataAsset MagicCommands pointer cache; normal Sora comes from configured battle commands. Reflective layout checks validate the struct and local byte-pointer caches.

Paired cockpit SetFlowScope wrapper: EGS 0x18de3e0 -> target owner 0x19dc890, Steam 0x1577520 -> 0x167a8f0. ABI bool(cockpit,int mode). Both target owners store the GFx scope pointer at +0x3a8. EGS runtime labels identify flowScope/flowScopeC and in/loop/out/off; native phase zero precedes the scope's out completion. Production only verifies this site and reads currentLabel for swap eligibility, allowing vanilla teardown to reach off; it never forces a scope mode. Diagnostic-only fixtures use mode 0 to open and mode 1 to close naturally. Mode 6 immediately hides the outline but can retain the filled circular filter. No target-marker entries are removed.
